summary.key_theme: 科技股漲勢強勁但市場廣度不足，投資人對於科技泡沫風險與資產配置集中度產生分歧。

bullish.title: Why Are Nasdaq, Dow Futures Rising Premarket? SPCX, NVDA, CEG, AMD, ORCL, NOK In Focus

bullish.title: Cathie Wood Claps Back After Being Confronted as ARKK Fell Nearly 15% While QQQ Soared 112% in Five Years
bullish.reason: 數據顯示 QQQ 在過去五年內實現 112% 的漲幅，展現出相較於其他主動型基金的強大長期績效。

bullish.title: Stocktwits Passport Portfolio: QQQ Holds Up Better Than SPY, DIA And Asian Stocks Amid Bond Market Rout This Week

bearish.title: International Markets Are Pulling Ahead Of US Stocks In 2026: These 4 ETFs Have Left SPY, QQQ, DIA In The Dust
bearish.reason: 國際市場在 2026 年表現優於美國市場，導致資金可能從 QQQ 等美股 ETF 流出。

bearish.title: Nearly All of QQQI’s Yield Was Return of Capital, Not Income. Here Is What That Does to Your Cost Basis
bearish.reason: 針對 QQQI 的配息結構分析，指出其收益多來自資本返還而非實際獲利，可能影響投資人的稅務成本與長期持有意願。

bearish.title: Why I'd Choose VOO Over QQQ For The Next 20 Years

neutral.title: Nvidia, Apple, Microsoft Now Drive 21% of S&P 500: Here’s How Much ETF Investors Own
neutral.reason: 報導指出科技巨頭對指數的影響力過大，這對 QQQ 而言是雙面刃，既是漲勢動力也是集中度風險。

neutral.title: Nasdaq 100 Records Have Rarely Been This Narrow, 55 Stocks Are Still Below 50-Day Average

neutral.title: Nasdaq, S&P 500, Dow Futures Steady Ahead Of Fed Minutes This Week

neutral.title: SPY and QQQ Hold Firm as Breadth Stabilizes, but Participation Remains Narrow

neutral.title: JEPQ: The Asymmetry Investors Are Missing
neutral.reason: 比較 JEPQ 與 QQQ 的績效差異，主要探討收益與波動的不對稱性，對 QQQ 本身無直接利多或利空影響。
